_note: Curated PNG logos for homelab-drawio diagrams. PNG, not SVG: headless Draw.io export does not render SVG data URIs. Embed with image=data:image/png,<base64> (a COMMA, never ';base64,', which truncates the mxCell style). Prefer scripts/icon_style.py style <name> --role <role> over hand-rolling a data URI. Icons are sourced from the recorded URL, fitted within a 64px PNG canvas with aspect preserved, and inspected at 24px.
_scope: Deployed platform products and explicitly labelled RFC/ADR candidates. Catalog presence does not establish adoption; diagram status follows the design record.
_aliases_note: victorialogs and victoriatraces share the VictoriaMetrics mark (one company, one logo) - label the box with the product name and let the shared mark stand.
